title_en: Video Game Release Dates: The Biggest Games Coming Soon - IGN
summary_en: An updated list of video game release dates for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, and PC games.
body_en:
October is here, bringing with it some of the biggest video games of the year. If you have a PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, or PC, you'll be eating just fine this month. This month is particularly big this year because most of the rest of the seaons's biggest games fled November to escape the shadow of GTA 6. So we'll get games like Gears of War: E-Day, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Final Fantasy Resonance, a little game called Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and many more. Read on to see release dates for all the biggest games and expansions coming out this month and beyond. Let's dive in.
If you're the preordering type, you can click the links for the platform of your choice to see the game at Amazon (if available).
For more release dates, check out our ongoing list of 4K UHD and Blu-ray release dates as well as all of the upcoming LEGO release dates .
